claim.description: the slogan on the welcome sign ("Geizig! Garstig! Steil!")

cells.description: the cover: row runs `[r, q0, q1]` – the cells `{ q, r }` for q0 ≤ q ≤ q1 (`regionCells` / `cellRuns`)

sign.description: the welcome sign (the Ortseingangsschild) – a CDN-root path

vegetation.description: what grows there (also the paint prompt when the region is repainted)

greeting.description: what the representative – or, without one, the narrator – says when someone moves in

representative.description: the elected representative: a character of the registry (elections later – set by hand until then)

colour.description: the region's colour on the map (#rrggbb)

LocaleText.description: Text per locale: `{ de: "Kostüm", en: "Costume Design" }`.

CellRun.description: one row of a region's cover: the cells `{ q, r }` from q0 to q1
